reject_reason: OVERRULE of adjudicator KEEP. Cross-lane borderline-dupe of accepted crustless-bacon-gruyere-quiche: both crustless oven-baked pork + egg + cheese no-starch bakes (3-4 of 4 axes; adjudicator could not see that pork acceptance). Also pork was already tied for most-represented protein (4 of 13) with more pork candidates streaming in - not padding a second pork egg bake.
